verses.original: ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה־ בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי־ רִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ paṯ ḥă·rê·ḇāh wə·šal·wāh- ḇāh mib·ba·yiṯ mā·lê ziḇ·ḥê- rîḇ
verses.literal: Better a dry morsel in quietness than a house full of feasting with strife

verses.original: עֶֽבֶד־ מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּבֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘e·ḇeḏ- maś·kîl yim·šōl bə·ḇên mê·ḇîš ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ ’a·ḥîm ya·ḥă·lōq na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share his inheritance as one of the brothers

verses.original: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: maṣ·rêp̄ lak·ke·sep̄ wə·ḵūr laz·zā·hāḇ ū·ḇō·ḥên lib·bō·wṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold but the LORD is the tester of hearts

verses.original: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־ שְׂפַת־ אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל־ לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֺּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: mê·ra‘ maq·šîḇ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- ’ā·wen še·qer mê·zîn ‘al- lə·šō·wn haw·wōṯ
verses.literal: A wicked man listens to evil lips a liar gives ear to a destructive tongue

verses.original: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō·‘êḡ lā·rāš ḥê·rêp̄ ‘ō·śê·hū śā·mê·aḥ lə·’êḏ lō yin·nā·qeh
verses.literal: He who mocks the poor insults their Maker whoever gloats over calamity will not go unpunished

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ zə·qê·nîm bə·nê ḇā·nîm wə·ṯip̄·’e·reṯ bā·nîm ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Grandchildren . . . are the crown of the aged and the glory of a son is his father

verses.original: לֹא־ נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת־ יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ לְנָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת־ שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- nā·wāh lə·nā·ḇāl śə·p̄aṯ- ye·ṯer ’ap̄ kî- lə·nā·ḏîḇ śə·p̄aṯ- šā·qer
verses.literal: Eloquent words are unfit . . . for a fool how much worse . . . are lying lips to a ruler

verses.original: אֶֽבֶן־ חֵ֣ן הַ֭שֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḇen- ḥên haš·šō·ḥaḏ bə·‘ê·nê ḇə·‘ā·lāw ’el- kāl- ’ă·šer yip̄·neh yaś·kîl
verses.literal: A bribe is a charm . . . to its giver wherever . . . he turns he succeeds

verses.original: מְֽכַסֶּה־ פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḵas·seh- pe·ša‘ mə·ḇaq·qêš ’a·hă·ḇāh wə·šō·neh ḇə·ḏā·ḇār map̄·rîḏ ’al·lūp̄
verses.literal: Whoever conceals an offense promotes love but he who brings it up . . . separates friends

verses.original: תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tê·ḥaṯ gə·‘ā·rāh ḇə·mê·ḇîn mê·hak·kō·wṯ kə·sîl mê·’āh
verses.literal: A rebuke cuts into a man of discernment deeper than a hundred lashes cut into a fool

verses.original: אַךְ־ מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ־ רָ֑ע וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- mə·rî yə·ḇaq·qeš- rā‘ ū·mal·’āḵ ’aḵ·zā·rî yə·šul·laḥ- bōw
verses.literal: An evil man seeks only rebellion a cruel messenger will be sent against him

verses.original: פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּאִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־ כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ḡō·wōš dōḇ šak·kūl bə·’îš wə·’al- kə·sîl bə·’iw·wal·tōw
verses.literal: It is better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא־ תָמִישׁ רָ֝עָ֗ה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·šîḇ rā·‘āh ta·ḥaṯ ṭō·w·ḇāh lō- ṯå̄·mīš rā·‘āh mib·bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: If anyone returns evil for good evil will never leave his house

verses.original: פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָרִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: pō·w·ṭêr ma·yim rê·šîṯ mā·ḏō·wn wə·lip̄·nê hiṯ·gal·la‘ hā·rîḇ nə·ṭō·wōš
verses.literal: To start a quarrel is to release a flood so abandon the dispute before it breaks out

verses.original: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: maṣ·dîq rā·šā‘ ū·mar·šî·a‘ ṣad·dîq tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh gam- šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous both are detestable to the LORD

verses.original: לָמָּה־ זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד־ כְּסִ֑יל לִקְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה וְלֶב־ אָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- zeh mə·ḥîr bə·yaḏ- kə·sîl liq·nō·wṯ ḥāḵ·māh wə·leḇ- ’ā·yin
verses.literal: Why . . . should the fool have money in his hand with no intention of buying wisdom

verses.original: בְּכָל־ עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָרֵ֑עַ וְאָ֥ח לְ֝צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ ’ō·hêḇ hā·rê·a‘ wə·’āḥ lə·ṣā·rāh yiw·wā·lêḏ
verses.literal: A friend loves at all times and a brother is born for adversity

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר־ לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִפְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām ḥă·sar- lêḇ tō·w·qê·a‘ kāp̄ ‘ō·rêḇ ‘ă·rub·bāh lip̄·nê rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: A man lacking judgment strikes hands in pledge and puts up security . . . for his neighbor

verses.original: אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ פִּ֝תְח֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־ שָֽׁבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ pe·ša‘ ’ō·hêḇ maṣ·ṣāh maḡ·bî·ah piṯ·ḥōw mə·ḇaq·qeš- šā·ḇer
verses.literal: He who loves transgression loves strife he who builds his gate high invites destruction

verses.original: עִקֶּשׁ־ לֵ֭ב לֹ֣א יִמְצָא־ ט֑וֹב וְנֶהְפָּ֥ךְ בִּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘iq·qeš- lêḇ lō yim·ṣā- ṭō·wḇ wə·neh·pāḵ bil·šō·w·nōw yip·pō·wl bə·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: The one with a perverse heart finds no good and he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble

verses.original: יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְת֣וּגָה ל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yō·lêḏ kə·sîl lə·ṯū·ḡāh lōw wə·lō- yiś·maḥ ’ă·ḇî nā·ḇāl
verses.literal: A man fathers a fool to his own grief the father of a fool has no joy

verses.original: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב גֵּהָ֑ה וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה תְּיַבֶּשׁ־ גָּֽרֶם׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ śā·mē·aḥ yê·ṭiḇ gê·hāh wə·rū·aḥ nə·ḵê·’āh tə·yab·beš- gā·rem
verses.literal: A joyful heart is good medicine but a broken spirit dries up the bones

verses.original: שֹׁ֣חַד מֵ֭חֵיק רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח לְ֝הַטּ֗וֹת אָרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: šō·ḥaḏ mê·ḥêq rā·šā‘ yiq·qāḥ lə·haṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: A wicked man takes a covert bribe to subvert the course of justice

verses.original: אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין חָכְמָ֑ה וְעֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּקְצֵה־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- pə·nê mê·ḇîn ḥāḵ·māh wə·‘ê·nê ḵə·sîl biq·ṣêh- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Wisdom is the focus of the discerning but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth

verses.original: כַּ֣עַס לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וּ֝מֶ֗מֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·‘as lə·’ā·ḇîw bên kə·sîl ū·me·mer lə·yō·w·laḏ·tōw
verses.literal: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to her who bore him

verses.original: גַּ֤ם עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַצַּדִּ֣יק לֹא־ ט֑וֹב לְהַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל־ יֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.transliteration: gam ‘ă·nō·wōš laṣ·ṣad·dîq lō- ṭō·wḇ lə·hak·kō·wṯ nə·ḏî·ḇîm ‘al- yō·šer
verses.literal: It is surely not good to punish the innocent or to flog a noble for his honesty

verses.original: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָיו יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת וְקַר ר֝֗וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·w·śêḵ ’ă·mā·rāw yō·w·ḏê·a‘ dā·‘aṯ wə·qar ’îš tə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: A man of knowledge . . . restrains his words and a man of understanding maintains a calm spirit

verses.original: גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל מַ֭חֲרִישׁ חָכָ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣יו נָבֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: gam ’ĕ·wîl ma·ḥă·rîš ḥā·ḵām yê·ḥā·šêḇ ’ō·ṭêm śə·p̄ā·ṯāw nā·ḇō·wn
verses.literal: Even a fool is considered wise if he keeps silent and discerning when he holds his tongue
